sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié de lǐwù
sentences.english: Teacher's Day Gift

sentences.pinyin: Jiǔyuè shí rì shì jiàoshījié.
sentences.english: September 10th is Teacher's Day.

sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì xiǎng gěi lǎoshī zhǔnbèi yī fèn lǐwù.
sentences.english: Teacher's Day was approaching, Xiaoming and Lili wanted to prepare a gift for their teacher.

sentences.pinyin: Xīngqītiān zǎoshang, tiānqì hěn hǎo, liǎng gè rén yīqǐ lái dào huāyuán lǐ.
sentences.english: Sunday morning, the weather was nice, and the two of them came to the garden together.

sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ de huā kāi dé yòu duō yòu piàoliang.
sentences.english: The flowers in the garden bloomed abundantly and beautifully.

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: “Nǐ kàn, zhèxiē huā duō xīnxiān a!
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, “Look, how fresh these flowers are!

sentences.pinyin: Wǒmen zhāi yīxiē sòng gěi lǎoshī, hǎo ma?”
sentences.english: Shall we pick some to give to the teacher?”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì gāoxìng de shuō: “Hǎo a!
sentences.english: Lili happily said, “Great!

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhèng xiǎngzhe zhè jiàn shì ne.
sentences.english: I was just thinking about that.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī měitiān dōu rènzhēn de jiāo wǒmen, wǒ hěn xiǎng shuō yī shēng ‘xièxie’.”
sentences.english: The teacher teaches us diligently every day, I really want to say ‘thank you’.”

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiǎoxīn de zhāi le jǐ duǒ zuì piàoliang de huā, ránhòu huí dào jiālǐ.
sentences.english: They carefully picked a few of the most beautiful flowers, then returned home.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì náchū zhǐ hé bǐ, zuò le yī zhāng kǎpiàn, zài kǎpiàn shàng xiě: “Lǎoshī, xièxie nín duì wǒmen de guānxīn hé bāngzhù.
sentences.english: Lili took out paper and pen, made a card, and wrote on it: “Teacher, thank you for your care and help.

sentences.pinyin: Zhù nín jiàoshījié kuàilè!”
sentences.english: Happy Teacher's Day to you!”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng yě zài kǎpiàn shàng huà le yī kē dàshù, yīnwèi lǎoshī chángcháng bāngzhù tāmen, jiù xiàng dàshù yīyàng.
sentences.english: Xiaoming also drew a big tree on the card, because the teacher often helps them, just like a big tree.

sentences.pinyin: Jiǔyuè shí rì zǎoshang, tāmen bǎ xiānhuā hé kǎpiàn sòng dào le lǎoshī de bàngōngshì.
sentences.english: On the morning of September 10th, they brought the flowers and cards to the teacher's office.

sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī kàndào lǐwù, yǎnjīng dōu hóng le.
sentences.english: When the teacher saw the gifts, her eyes turned red.

sentences.pinyin: Tā xiàozhe shuō: “Xièxie nǐmen!
sentences.english: She smiled and said, “Thank you!

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ shōudào de zuì hǎo de lǐwù.”
sentences.english: This is the best gift I've ever received.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì tīng le, xīn lǐ bǐ chī le táng hái tián.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili heard this, and their hearts felt sweeter than eating candy.

sentences.pinyin: Nà tiān yǐhòu, tāmen míngbái le: shuō “xièxie” huì ràng biérén kuàilè, zìjǐ yě huì gèng kuàilè.
sentences.english: After that day, they understood: saying “thank you” makes others happy, and you yourself will be even happier.
